findings.finding: The H1 2026 balance sheet date is 30 June 2026, which predates BOTH of Innate's cash events (the Sobi $75m upfront announced 10 Aug and the EUR 30m placement priced 14 Aug), so the headline cash line will be roughly EUR 12-13m against ~EUR 20m of financial liabilities -- i.e. negative net cash -- derived from the company's own disclosed trajectory of EUR 44.8m at 31-Dec-2025 and EUR 25.4m at 31-Mar-2026 with runway guided only to 'end of Q3 2026'.

The Sobi USD 75m upfront -- the entire basis of the 'cash runway through Q1 2028' guidance -- is stated in the deal release as 'payable on closing', with closing 'subject to closing conditions, including the receipt of transaction related anti-trust clearance', and 37 days after signing NEITHER Innate's own press-release index NOR Sobi's carries any completion announcement.

At the H.C. Wainwright fireside chat on 2026-09-14 management gave, for the first time publicly, a first-patient-enrolled date for the confirmatory Phase 3 TELLOMAK-3 of 'early 2027' -- against prior public guidance of trial initiation in H1 2026 (Nov-2025) and then H2 2026 (May-2026) -- and the trial still has no ClinicalTrials.gov registration of any kind.

PACIFIC-9's ClinicalTrials.gov record carries an estimated primary completion date of 2026-09-30 -- thirteen days after this print -- with enrollment already ACTUAL at 1,051 and status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, and the 17 Sept call is the last scheduled management appearance before a monalizumab readout worth up to EUR 825m of milestones plus royalties against a ~$219m market cap.

findings.finding: Lennar's own full-year target of 'approximately 82,000 to 83,000 homes' arithmetically requires a Q4 of 23,118-25,118 deliveries (Q1 16,863 + Q2 20,519 = 37,382; Q3 guided 20,500-21,500), i.e. +0.4% to +9.0% against the 23,034 of Q4 FY25 which was itself the largest delivery quarter in company history, at a moment when new orders are guided down 4-9% year over year against the 23,004 comp.

Lennar has printed at or below the bottom of its own guided ranges for two consecutive quarters: Q1 FY26 delivered 16,863 homes against a guide of 17,000-18,000 (below the range entirely) with gross margin 15.2% against a guided 15.0-16.0%, and Q2 FY26 gross margin was 15.6% against a guided 15.5-16.0% — so the Q3 guide of 'approximately 16%' more plausibly prints 15.5-15.8%.

Lennar's Q4 order quarter (September-November) opened with the MBA 30-year fixed contract rate at 6.97% for the week ending 2026-09-11, up 12bp week over week, after the MBA Builder Application Survey showed new-home purchase applications fell 6% month over month and 5.5% year over year in August — a fifth consecutive monthly decline, with MBA's implied new-home sales pace 9% below a year ago and the average new-home loan size down to $373,194 from $374,438.

The offsetting leg: roughly 8.5% of LEN's free float is short and up about 4.5% over the past month on a cheap 0.37% borrow, the stock sits 2.6% off a 52-week low and 40% off its high, the 25-delta skew is -0.77 (calls richer than puts), and the industry gross-margin cycle is visibly inflecting up — Hovnanian's May-July quarter reported homebuilding gross margin of 14.6% before interest and land charges, improving sequentially for a second consecutive quarter, the same shape as Lennar's own 15.2% to 15.6% to ~16% sequence.

findings.finding: Aeluma's own narrowed FY26 guide of $4.2-4.6m against nine-month revenue of $3.879m implies a Q4 of $321-721k, so the fiscal-year quarterly sequence is $1.4m -> $1.3m -> $1.2m -> ~$0.59m (a 58% decline across the year), FY26 revenue will be the company's first-ever annual DECLINE ($4.2-4.6m vs FY25's $4.7m), and the FY2027 guidance the company must issue tonight has to be anchored to an exit run-rate annualising to ~$2.3m against a ~$245m market cap (18,305,335 shares x $13.375), i.e. ~104x exit-rate revenue.

The Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies agreement announced 2026-09-15, one trading day before the print, is a procurement agreement in which SCAT supplies epiwafers TO Aeluma using SCAT's own Phoenix MOCVD tools - the trade press headline is literally 'Sumitomo Chemical Advanced Technologies to provide epiwafers for Aeluma' - yet it carries no disclosed financial terms, volumes or exclusivity, the SCAT relationship was already public in April 2026, and the stock took +4.70% on it (close $12.54 on 09-14 to $13.13 on 09-15).

The $50,000,000 ATM launched 2026-03-20 is essentially undrawn: shares outstanding were 18,305,335 on 2026-08-26 per the shares-outstanding field of Steven DenBaars' Form 144, against 18,002,949 on 2026-03-17 per the 424B5 cover - just +302,386 shares (+1.7%) across five months, consistent with equity compensation alone, where a meaningfully used $50m programme would have issued roughly 3.5m shares.
